name: refill-store
description: Refill Store — Plataforma web de recargas automáticas para Free Fire y Blood Strike

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix functions
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --prefix functions && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.dev:api:full: npm run build --prefix functions && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix functions && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix functions
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
